clippings.speaker: John Lasseter
clippings.quote: He never speaks down to an audience in either the songs or the score. It’s always from an adult point of view.
clippings.title: White Man With Attitude
clippings.context: Lasseter, a Pixar director and frequent co-worker, explaining in a profile why he chose Newman to score kid-oriented films.
